# Biloute by Rahenda

> Personal website and blog of Biloute (Rahenda), a product manager based in Rennes,
> France, with a background in engineering, DevOps/network engineering, and
> B2B sales, currently working in business development for enterprise telecom
> APIs. Site is in French (some content) and English (site chrome).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) for making a
site's key information directly retrievable by AI assistants without requiring
HTML scraping.

## Profile

- [About / Profile]({{ "/about.html" | absolute_url }}): Biography — career path from
  semiconductor manufacturing, to DevOps/network engineering, to product
  management, to Paris 2024 Olympics telecom infrastructure, to business
  development for enterprise APIs.
